description: English question about a finished action. The answer should say it was sent and cite the email
question: Did I already send the invoice to Mina?

sources.title: September invoice
sources.text:
From: Doyun
To: Mina Park
Subject: September invoice

Hi Mina,
I've attached the September invoice as promised. Let me know if anything looks off.

Best,
Doyun

sources.title: Monthly sync with Mina
sources.text:
Mina: Could you send over the September invoice next week?
Doyun: Sure, I'll send the invoice by Wednesday.

quotes.quote: I've attached the September invoice as promised
I'll send the invoice by Wednesday
